E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mountain of Madness: An avalanche traps Homer and Mr Burns in a mountain cabin during a team-building exercise. (S8 Ep12/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala (Annoyed Grunt) cious: Supernanny Shary Bobbins comes to the rescue of Marge, who is so stressed that her hair has started to fall out. (S8 Ep13/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Itchy & Scratchy & Poochie Show: Homer gets a job on The Itchy & Scratchy Show as the voice of hip-hop surfer dog Poochie, a character brought in to boost viewing figures. (S8 Ep14/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer's Phobia: Homer's prejudices surface when Bart befriends a gay shop owner (guest star John Waters). So he decides to take Bart hunting - but it doesn't go to plan. (S8 Ep15/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brother from Another Series: Sideshow Bob (guest star Kelsey Grammer) is once again released from prison, into the care of his respectable brother Cecil (David Hyde Pierce). (S8 Ep16/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Rednecks and Broomsticks: Homer discovers that Cletus and his pals are making moonshine. Lisa gets to know three teenage Wiccans. Guest starring Neve Campbell. (S21 Ep7/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Great Christmas Bake Off 2025
E4Plus1.uk.description: Ding dong merrily on pie! Deck the ovens and take a peep into the tent, as stars from Peep Show create biscuit decorations, a Boxing Day classic and their favourite moments in cake form.

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Boy Meets Curl: When Homer takes Marge out for a romantic evening at the ice rink, they become hooked on curling and end up competing to reach the Winter Olympics. (S21 Ep12/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Color Yellow: Lisa finds her ancestor Eliza Simpson's diary, which describes a remarkable 19th-century adventure. (S21 Ep13/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Squirt and the Whale: The Simpsons put up a wind turbine in their back garden. Lisa has an upsetting experience when she attempts to free a beached whale. (S21 Ep19/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Independence Day: Resurgence

E4Plus1.uk.description: What do Denise Van Outen, Rylan, Gyles Brandreth, Mo Gilligan, Shaun Ryder et al think of Planet Earth II, Big Brother: Best Shows Ever, Grease, Dating Around, Misery and more top telly?

E4Plus1.uk.description: It's Asia, Meet the Rees-Moggs and How to Heat Your Home for Less This Winter on Gogglebox this time. Plus: Scam Interceptors, The Last Woodsmen and Subservience.  (S24 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: What do Britain's finest sofa critics think of You Bet!, Black Doves, Jamie Cooks Christmas, Wolf Hall: The Mirror and the Light, and Swiped: The School That Banned Smartphones? (S24 Ep14) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Model Georgia returns for a date with nice guy Alex, who she flirted with last time. And will fifties fashionista Amy go to a Northern Soul night with Rob the Mod after their date? (S4 Ep9) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Self-confessed nerd and Star Wars fan Lachlan returns. Is his date with Becca out of this world? Young professionals Louisa and Cameron take time out from working life for a date. (S4 Ep10) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: What do Britain's finest sofa critics think of You Bet!, Black Doves, Jamie Cooks Christmas, Wolf Hall: The Mirror and the Light, and Swiped: The School That Banned Smartphones? (S24 Ep14) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride
E4Plus1.uk.description: The One at a Welsh Theme Park: Thrill-seeking Tom wants to give the love of his life Becca the ride of her life, as he plans their wedding at his favourite theme park.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks Omnibus
E4Plus1.uk.description: There's horror in the woods for two McQueens. And with secrets and emotions bubbling close to the surface, the Hutchinson teens' sweet 16th goes up in flames...

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Message Received: Jay, Gloria and Manny challenge each other to step outside their comfort zone and try something new. Mitch and Cam's wedding is getting too big and costly. (S5 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Wedding, Part 1: Mitch and Cam's big day arrives and nothing can ruin it - until nothing turns into a whole lot of somethings and puts wedding planner Pepper to the test. (S5 Ep23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Wedding, Part 2: Wedding day chaos continues as the party shifts from one contingency plan to another. Guests start getting testy, and Mitchell and Cameron become discouraged. (S5 Ep24)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gordon Returns 1: Gordon revisits three restaurants - Handlebar, Casa Roma and The Black Pearl - to check in with the owners he helped. Has his advice been put to good use? (S3 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Great British Bake Off

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Streetcar Named Marge: Homer's boorishness inspires Marge to give the performance of a lifetime in a musical version of A Streetcar Named Desire. (S4 Ep2/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
